Store Products Don't Work Here

Big box mosquito sprays and candles provide minimal relief in Alabama's high-pressure summer environment. Professional barrier treatments are a different category entirely.

Treats the Source, Not the Symptom

We treat vegetation, tree lines, and shaded areas where mosquitoes rest during the day — eliminating them before they bite, not after.

Protection That Lasts

Each application creates a barrier that remains effective for 3–4 weeks. Monthly programs maintain continuous coverage through peak season.

How Our Mosquito Program Works

Simple, recurring, effective

01

Free Inspection

We assess your property — yard size, vegetation, standing water risk, and peak exposure areas.

02

First Treatment

Full barrier application to vegetation, shrubs, tree lines, deck undersides, and all shaded resting areas.

03

Monthly Follow-up

Return every 3–4 weeks through season. Consistent coverage is what separates good results from great ones.

04

Season-End Review

At end of season we assess results, adjust plan for next year, and set you up for early April start.
